name: Lisa
source: A student at Lind Academy and part of Mia’s close-knit friend group, Lisa finds herself unwillingly entangled in the growing vampire conspiracy overtaking Lind. As those around her fall to its influence, a fateful encounter places her directly in the path of Ben and his brood. One of the few who still sees clearly, Lisa must confront the spreading darkness and decide whether she can resist it long enough to stop it.
